## Showtimes

- This week's films and showtimes: {{ base }}/#now-showing
- What's booked next: {{ base }}/#coming-soon

Films are all on the home page; there are no separate film pages. Now
Showing, at the top, lists each film playing this week with its showtimes,
rating, runtime and trailer. Coming Soon shows no showtimes: it lists the
films booked after this week, with trailers, as a grid or a month calendar.

There is no online ticketing. Pay at the box office, which opens
{{ site_config.box_office.opens_before_show_minutes }} minutes before every show.

The phone line, {{ site_config.cinema.phone }}, reads out this week's showtimes and ticket
prices, and takes messages.

To hear about new showings by email, join the mailing list from the home
page. It sends a confirmation link first.

## Ticket prices (USD)

- Adults: ${{ ticket_prices.adult }}
- Seniors: ${{ ticket_prices.senior }}
- Kids: ${{ ticket_prices.child }}
- Matinees (showtimes at {{ ticket_prices.matinee_until|time:"g A" }} or earlier): ${{ ticket_prices.matinee }}

## Rentals, advertising

- Rent the Cinema, private rentals of the whole theater: {{ base }}/rentals/
- Advertise, advertising on the big screen before every show: {{ base }}/advertise/
  - Pre-show slide: ${{ ad_slide_price }} a month. Video spot (up to {{ ad_video_max_seconds }} seconds): ${{ ad_video_price }} a month. Prices in US dollars, month to month, no contract.

Both pages have an inquiry form.
